line_items.reasoning: JNJ raised its full-year 2025 operational sales guidance midpoint to $92.0B (3.8% growth), up $700M from the prior $91.3B midpoint, and Q1 sales grew 4.2% operationally — ahead of the 2.5%–3.5% full-year operational growth range guided in Q4-2024.

Full-year adjusted EPS guidance was maintained at a $10.50–$10.70 midpoint, which is slightly below the prior $10.60 reported midpoint but effectively held steady given the absorption of ~$0.25 Intra-Cellular dilution and new tariff headwinds, suggesting performance is tracking in line with the underlying operational EPS target.

Gross margins compressed ~320 bps YoY in Q1 due to STELARA mix headwinds, Part D redesign, and unfavorable transactional currency, and management acknowledged consensus was too optimistic on gross profit — falling short of the guided ~300 bps improvement in adjusted pretax operating margins.
